# Catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run build` from catalog/standard.yaml and src/kinds.ts. Do not edit. -->

The source every target is built from. One standard holds for every artifact; this page is that
standard, generated from the data `sigil sync --check` enforces
([family-skeleton-standard-2026-10.md](../docs/decisions/family-skeleton-standard-2026-10.md),
[catalog-layout-standard-2026-10.md](../docs/decisions/catalog-layout-standard-2026-10.md)).

## Where an artifact goes

- No language variation: `shared/`.
- Varies with the project's language: `languages/<language>/`, prefixed with the language's
  `prefix` (`ts-`, `py-`, ...). Each language names its prefix and stack in `language.yaml`.
- Varies with a stack the task chooses: one neutral shared skill; each stack's text is a stack
  part in the language that owns the stack (`languages/<home>/stack-parts/<skill>.md`), shipped
  as the skill's `references/stack-<id>.md` and listed by a generated table
  (`<!-- stack-index -->` in SKILL.md). `shared/` never holds language-specific text.

Grouping for installs lives in `packs.yaml`, never in folders.

## Files per kind

| Kind | File | Delivered as |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mcp | `mcps/<name>.mcp.md` | merged into a JSON config |
| hook | `hooks/<name>.hook.md` | merged into a JSON config |
| settings | `settings/<name>.settings.md` | merged into a JSON config |
| prompt | `prompts/<name>.prompt.md` | whole file |
| skill | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (+ optional `references/`) | whole file |
| agent | `agents/<name>.agent.md` | whole file |
| rule | `rules/<name>.rule.md` | whole file |
| workflow | `workflows/<name>.workflow.md` | whole file |
| template | `templates/<name>.template.md` | not delivered on its own (no target emits it) |

## Skill anatomy

Every skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`: the steps, always. Its family decides whether it also
carries a flat `references/` folder, and which files, by role:

- **core**: detail the steps read on demand, so `SKILL.md` stays short;
- **brief**: the hand-off an agent reads (an auditor reads its skill's brief);
- **examples**: worked examples;
- **stack**: one `stack-<id>.md` per declared stack, all with one H2 skeleton, read one at a time.

A family that declares no references is `SKILL.md` only, the official minimum of every tool. A
skill carries references only when it outgrows one file or holds variants used one at a time.
Every target ships reference files next to `SKILL.md` and translates them like the body.

## Families

Every agent, rule and skill belongs to exactly one family. Members share their H2 sections (in
order), set exactly the family's frontmatter keys, take its title, carry its reference files
and load rules and agents from the same families.

## Stacks, severities and bases

- Stacks: `dotnet` (.NET, home `csharp`), `go` (Go, home `go`), `node-ts` (Node.js / TypeScript, home `typescript`), `python` (Python, home `python`), `rust` (Rust, home `rust`).
- Report severities, highest first: Critical, High, Medium, Low.
- Bases (shared rules other rules extend): `shared/clean-code`, `shared/git`.
